courses.name: ENDURO RACER
courses.description: Five stages of dirt, end to end! Grasslands, desert, a forest lake and rolling dunes, then a dash along the beach to the finish. Clear the logs and fly the ramps!

courses.name: SUPER HANG-ON AFRICA
courses.description: The BEGINNER course: six stages across Africa, the shortest and gentlest of the four. Golden dunes give way to rocky mountains on the horizon. Long straights, easy bends!

courses.name: SUPER HANG-ON ASIA
courses.description: The JUNIOR course: ten stages across Asia. A pagoda among jagged peaks, a city skyline at dusk, then the open sea. The road bends and bends again!

courses.name: SUPER HANG-ON AMERICA
courses.description: The SENIOR course: fourteen stages across America. Skyscrapers, snowy ranges and red desert buttes roll by. The straights open up and the hills climb higher. Hang on!

courses.name: SUPER HANG-ON EUROPE
courses.description: The EXPERT course: eighteen stages across Europe. The Eiffel Tower, windmills, the snowy Alps and a city by night. The longest, twistiest, hilliest ride of all!

courses.name: OUTRUN A
courses.description: Left at every fork! From Coconut Beach, under Gateway's giant stone arches, across the Desert and the cactus-strewn Wilderness, then on into the Vineyard for GOAL A.

courses.name: OUTRUN B
courses.description: Under Gateway's stone arches, through the flowers and windmills of the Alps, down the Old Capital's tree-lined main street, then into the red rock of Death Valley for GOAL B.

courses.name: OUTRUN C LEFT
courses.description: Gateway's stone arches, the windmills of the Alps, then a crooked lane through the golden Wheat Field to the crumbling ruins of Desolation Hill. GOAL C, the left way round!

courses.name: OUTRUN C RIGHT
courses.description: Right into Devil's Canyon, under the cliffs! Then over the Alps and through the Old Capital's stone streets to the ruins of Desolation Hill. GOAL C, the right way round!

courses.name: OUTRUN D
courses.description: Devil's Canyon, the Alps, the golden Wheat Field, then the wide-open Autobahn: fast bends all the way to GOAL D. Flat out!

courses.name: OUTRUN E
courses.description: Right at every fork! Through Devil's Canyon, up the misty slopes of Cloudy Mountain, past the white walls of Seaside Town, and on to the Lakeside for GOAL E.

courses.name: OUTRUN SHORT A
courses.description: A short run from the Desert! Ride the drifting dunes, wind along the cactus trail of the Wilderness, then cruise into the Vineyard's green countryside for GOAL A.

courses.name: OUTRUN SHORT B
courses.description: A short run from the Desert! Over the dunes, through the cactus-strewn Wilderness, then into Death Valley: red rock and sharp turns all the way to GOAL B.

courses.name: OUTRUN SHORT C LEFT
courses.description: A short run from the Desert! Cross the dunes, roll down the Old Capital's tree-lined main street, then out to the crumbling ruins of Desolation Hill for GOAL C.

courses.name: OUTRUN SHORT C RIGHT
courses.description: A short run from Cloudy Mountain! Climb into the clouds, cruise the crooked lanes of the golden Wheat Field, then cross the sandy wastes of Desolation Hill to GOAL C.

courses.name: OUTRUN SHORT D
courses.description: A short run from Cloudy Mountain! Down past the white walls and cliffs of Seaside Town, then onto the Autobahn: wide lanes and fast bends all the way to GOAL D!

courses.name: OUTRUN SHORT E
courses.description: A short run from Cloudy Mountain! Down to the cliffs and white walls of Seaside Town, then a green highway all the way to the Lakeside for GOAL E.

courses.name: TURBO OUTRUN SECTION 1
courses.description: New York to Indianapolis! The Manhattan skyline, the Washington Monument and the Capitol under gray skies, Pittsburgh's snowy peaks, then Indianapolis under a red sunset.

courses.name: TURBO OUTRUN SECTION 2
courses.description: Chicago to Atlanta! Skyscrapers under the stars, St. Louis's tree-lined bends, Memphis in the golden afternoon, then moonlit dunes at Atlanta.

courses.name: TURBO OUTRUN SECTION 3
courses.description: Miami to Dallas, from surf to sand! The Miami seashore, New Orleans at dusk, then west into the dry hills of San Antonio and the desert sands of Dallas.

courses.name: TURBO OUTRUN SECTION 4
courses.description: Oklahoma City to Los Angeles! Steel bridges and green hills, the snowy Rockies at Denver, the Grand Canyon under a golden sky, then the night lights of L.A. and the GOAL!

courses.name: POLE POSITION 2 FUJI
courses.description: Fuji, 1975 to 1983: the banking is gone, the chicanes yet to come. One of racing's longest straights, then the First Corner, 100R, the hairpin and the fast 300R.

courses.name: POLE POSITION 2 TEST
courses.description: The TEST track: an Indy-style oval with four left turns and two long straights. Race under the arch while a biplane tows its banner overhead. Watch for the puddles!

courses.name: POLE POSITION 2 SUZUKA
courses.description: Suzuka in 1983, just after its first chicane went in before the last corner. The rest is still 1962: the first two corners as one, the esses, a single Degner and the old Spoon.

courses.name: POLE POSITION 2 SEASIDE
courses.description: Long Beach as raced in 1982, its only year in this shape: Queen's Hairpin gone for square corners, a new loop out to Seaside Way, and a chicane on Shoreline Drive.

courses.name: FINAL LAP 2 JAPAN
courses.description: Suzuka, 1985 to 1987: the first two corners rebuilt in '85 with a straight between them, the Spoon tightened in '84, one long Degner until its '87 split, and the chicane.

courses.name: FINAL LAP 2 MONACO
courses.description: Monte Carlo's 1986 to 1996 layout, minus the new harbor chicane: Sainte Devote, Casino Square, the Loews hairpin, the tunnel, then flat out to Tabac, the pool and Rascasse.

courses.name: FINAL LAP 2 ITALY
courses.description: Monza's 1976 to 1993 layout, minus the Rettifilo and Roggia chicanes: flat out from the line through the Curva Grande to the Lesmos. Only the Ascari breaks the run to the Parabolica.

courses.name: FINAL LAP 2 USA
courses.description: An American speed bowl under a desert sunset: two long straights and two great sweeping right-handers. Built for pure speed, so hold it flat and hang on!

courses.name: TOP SPEED A
courses.description: Five stages across America! Road A keeps left at every fork, from the starting line all the way to the goal.

courses.name: TOP SPEED B
courses.description: Five stages across America! Road B breaks right in the second stage, then takes the second road through every split after that.

courses.name: TOP SPEED C
courses.description: Five stages across America! Road C keeps left in the second stage, then takes the third road through every split after that.

courses.name: TOP SPEED D
courses.description: Five stages across America! Road D breaks right in the second stage, keeps left in the third, then takes the fourth road through the last two stages.

courses.name: TOP SPEED E
courses.description: Five stages across America! Road E keeps left in the second stage, takes the middle road in the third, then the fifth road through the last two stages.

courses.name: TOP SPEED F
courses.description: Five stages across America! Road F breaks right in the second and third stages, takes the sixth road in the fourth, then swings back to the left for the finish.

courses.name: TOP SPEED G
courses.description: Five stages across America! Road G keeps left through the first three stages, takes the right-hand road through the fourth, then the second road home.

courses.name: CONTINENTAL CIRCUS BRAZIL
courses.description: Rio's Jacarepagua, 1978 to 1995, before the oval came: flat and counterclockwise, with a long pit straight and an even longer back straight lined with grandstands.

courses.name: CONTINENTAL CIRCUS AMERICA
courses.description: Watkins Glen, 1975 to 1985: the long course with the Boot, added in 1971, and the chicane that slowed the Esses from 1975. The 90, the Esses, the back straight, then round the Boot.

courses.name: CONTINENTAL CIRCUS FRANCE
courses.description: Dijon-Prenois, lengthened in 1977 with the Parabolique loop: a short, fast run of sweeping bends through the Burgundy hills, with a long main straight.

courses.name: CONTINENTAL CIRCUS MONACO
courses.description: Monte Carlo, 1976 to 1985: Sainte Devote and Antony Noghes tightened in '76, the fast old harbor chicane until '86. Casino Square, the Loews hairpin, the tunnel, Tabac.

courses.name: CONTINENTAL CIRCUS GERMANY
courses.description: Hockenheim, 1970 to 1981: the forest straights with their two fast chicanes of 1970, and the Ostkurve flat out, before its 1982 chicane. Then into the packed stadium.

courses.name: CONTINENTAL CIRCUS SPAIN
courses.description: Jarama, north of Madrid, as built in 1967 and raced until 1979, before the Bugatti hairpin was cut back: one short straight, then tight, twisty corners all the way round.

courses.name: CONTINENTAL CIRCUS MEXICO
courses.description: A dead ringer for Long Beach as raced from 1976 to 1981: a long Shoreline Drive with a hairpin at each end, Queen's and Le Gasomet, then square corners through downtown.

courses.name: CONTINENTAL CIRCUS JAPAN
courses.description: Suzuka as built in 1962 and raced until 1983, before any chicane: the first two corners as one long right, the esses, a single Degner, the old Spoon, then flat out through 130R.

courses.name: CHASE H.Q. STAGE 1 LEFT
courses.description: Out of the city of tall towers, bound for the suburbs. Left at the fork!

courses.name: CHASE H.Q. STAGE 1 RIGHT
courses.description: Tall towers, a highway tunnel and the open plains, bound for the suburbs. Right at the fork!

courses.name: CHASE H.Q. STAGE 2 LEFT
courses.description: Down the coast road and out into the wilds. Left at the fork!

courses.name: CHASE H.Q. STAGE 2 RIGHT
courses.description: Down the coast road and out into the wilds. Right at the fork!

courses.name: CHASE H.Q. STAGE 3 LEFT
courses.description: Neighborhood streets, then off the asphalt and onto the dirt, out toward the suburbs. Left at the fork!

courses.name: CHASE H.Q. STAGE 3 RIGHT
courses.description: Neighborhood streets, out toward the suburbs. Right at the fork!

courses.name: CHASE H.Q. STAGE 4 LEFT
courses.description: From the slums to the edge of town and out into the open desert. Left at the fork!

courses.name: CHASE H.Q. STAGE 4 RIGHT
courses.description: From the slums to the edge of town and out into the open desert. Right at the fork!

courses.name: CHASE H.Q. STAGE 5 LEFT
courses.description: A village, a tunnel and a canyon, all the way out to the suburbs. Left at the fork!

courses.name: CHASE H.Q. STAGE 5 RIGHT
courses.description: A village, a tunnel and a canyon, all the way out to the suburbs. Right at the fork!

courses.name: BIG RUN STARTING RUN
courses.description: The 11th Rally starts here! Out of Tunis and south past the palms to the oasis of Tozeur, on the edge of the Sahara.

courses.name: BIG RUN SPECIAL STAGE 1
courses.description: Tozeur to Tumu! Across the border into Libya, then the long road south.

courses.name: BIG RUN SPECIAL STAGE 2
courses.description: Tumu to Agadez, deep in the Sahara! A fast desert stage: pin the throttle, read the dunes and stay on the piste.

courses.name: BIG RUN SPECIAL STAGE 3
courses.description: Agadez to Bamako! Out of the Sahara toward the Niger River, with a river to cross on the way. Make a splash!

courses.name: BIG RUN SPECIAL STAGE 4
courses.description: Bamako to Saint-Louis, the last special stage! All the way west to the Atlantic coast of Senegal.

courses.name: BIG RUN VICTORY RUN
courses.description: The Victory Run! From Saint-Louis down the Atlantic coast to Dakar and the finish line of the 11th Rally.

courses.name: CISCO HEAT STAGE 1
courses.description: The hilly streets of the city by the bay! Steep climbs, sudden dives and ninety-degree corners all the way.

courses.name: CISCO HEAT STAGE 2
courses.description: The hilly streets of the city by the bay! Steep climbs, sudden dives and ninety-degree corners all the way.

courses.name: CISCO HEAT STAGE 3
courses.description: The hilly streets of the city by the bay! Steep climbs, sudden dives and ninety-degree corners all the way.

courses.name: CISCO HEAT STAGE 4
courses.description: The hilly streets of the city by the bay! Steep climbs, sudden dives and ninety-degree corners all the way.

courses.name: CISCO HEAT STAGE 5
courses.description: The hilly streets of the city by the bay! Steep climbs, sudden dives and ninety-degree corners all the way.

courses.name: TSUKUBA
courses.description: Tsukuba in 1989, before the 1990 chicane for bikes: a long right at the first corner, the esses, two hairpins, then the back straight into the fast final corner.
